name: com.cars-data/car-specs-api
title: cars-data.com — Car Specs API
description: Search, compare & filter 103,372 car variants — 232 specs, 20 languages. Free demo, no key; x402.

tools.name: search_cars
tools.description: Free-text search across 103,372 vehicle variants, 120 brands, 20 languages. Returns candidate variant_ids to pass to get_specs/get_images/compare_variants. Each result carries generation_id and production years so same-named variants from different generations can be told apart. This answers from a fixed 40-car demo set. For the full 103,372-variant catalogue call search_catalogue — paid per call with x402 (USDC on Base), $0.005, no key, no account.

query.description: Free text matched against brand, model and variant names, accent- and punctuation-insensitive — e.g. 'bmw 3 series' or 'tesla model s'.

locale.description: Response language, one of the 20 published languages (en, ro, fr, de, es, it, sr, hr, pt, pl, cs, sk, hu, no, sv, el, bg, da, ar, tr). Spec labels and enum values come back translated. Default: en.

tools.name: get_specs
tools.description: Full localized specs for one vehicle variant, in any of 20 languages — 232 spec types covering engine & fuel, performance, EV/hybrid, safety, comfort & interior, exterior, chassis, dimensions & weights, consumption (WLTP/NEDC). Each spec carries a confidence score; the response carries last_synced_at — surface both so you don't overstate certainty. This answers from a fixed 40-car demo set. For the full 103,372-variant catalogue call get_specs_full — paid per call with x402 (USDC on Base), $0.05, no key, no account.

variant_id.description: Opaque variant id from search_cars or filter_cars, e.g. v_1a2b3c4d

locale.description: Response language, one of the 20 published languages (en, ro, fr, de, es, it, sr, hr, pt, pl, cs, sk, hu, no, sv, el, bg, da, ar, tr). Spec labels and enum values come back translated. Default: en.

tools.name: compare_variants
tools.description: Side-by-side localized specs for 2-4 vehicle variants. This answers from a fixed 40-car demo set. For the full 103,372-variant catalogue call compare_full — paid per call with x402 (USDC on Base), $0.1, no key, no account.

variant_ids.description: 2 to 4 opaque variant ids from search_cars or filter_cars, e.g. ['v_1a2b3c4d', 'v_5e6f7a8b']

locale.description: Response language, one of the 20 published languages (en, ro, fr, de, es, it, sr, hr, pt, pl, cs, sk, hu, no, sv, el, bg, da, ar, tr). Spec labels and enum values come back translated. Default: en.

tools.name: list_generations
tools.description: Generations/facelifts of a model, with production years. This answers from a fixed 40-car demo set. Full catalogue: pay per request with x402, no key (GET /v1/variants/{id}/specs $0.05, /v1/search $0.005, /v1/variants $0.005, /v1/compare $0.1, USDC on Base); or the Apify Actor, billed per event by Apify (https://apify.com/carsdatacom/car-specs-api).

model_id.description: Opaque model id from a search_cars or filter_cars result, e.g. m_1a2b3c4d

locale.description: Response language, one of the 20 published languages (en, ro, fr, de, es, it, sr, hr, pt, pl, cs, sk, hu, no, sv, el, bg, da, ar, tr). Spec labels and enum values come back translated. Default: en.

tools.name: filter_cars
tools.description: Structured catalog filter: fuel type, body type, drive layout, power/price range, model year, EV-only. This answers from a fixed 40-car demo set. For the full 103,372-variant catalogue call filter_catalogue — paid per call with x402 (USDC on Base), $0.005, no key, no account.

fuel.description: Fuel type, case-insensitive substring of the English label — e.g. petrol, diesel, electric, hybrid

body.description: Body type, case-insensitive substring of the English label — e.g. suv, sedan, hatchback

drive.description: Drive layout, substring match — e.g. 'front', 'rear', 'all'. Not applied by the demo set — reported back in ignored_filters.

year.description: Production year the generation covers, e.g. 2022. Not applied by the demo set — reported back in ignored_filters.

ev.description: true = only variants with a traction battery (battery_kwh set: electric and plug-in). Default: false

locale.description: Response language, one of the 20 published languages (en, ro, fr, de, es, it, sr, hr, pt, pl, cs, sk, hu, no, sv, el, bg, da, ar, tr). Spec labels and enum values come back translated. Default: en.

tools.name: get_images
tools.description: Image URLs (own CDN, no attribution burden) for a vehicle variant. This answers from a fixed 40-car demo set. Full catalogue: pay per request with x402, no key (GET /v1/variants/{id}/specs $0.05, /v1/search $0.005, /v1/variants $0.005, /v1/compare $0.1, USDC on Base); or the Apify Actor, billed per event by Apify (https://apify.com/carsdatacom/car-specs-api).

variant_id.description: Opaque variant id from search_cars or filter_cars, e.g. v_1a2b3c4d

tools.name: search_catalogue
tools.description: Search all 103,372 variants (not only the 40-car demo). Returns opaque variant_ids for get_specs_full. Paid per call with x402 (USDC) — $0.005.

query.description: Free text matched against brand, model and variant names, accent- and punctuation-insensitive — e.g. 'bmw 3 series' or 'tesla model s'.

locale.description: Response language, one of the 20 published languages (en, ro, fr, de, es, it, sr, hr, pt, pl, cs, sk, hu, no, sv, el, bg, da, ar, tr). Spec labels and enum values come back translated. Default: en.

tools.name: get_specs_full
tools.description: Full localized specs for ANY variant in the catalogue, in 20 languages. Paid per call with x402 (USDC) — $0.05. Not charged when the id is unknown.

variant_id.description: Opaque variant id from search_catalogue, e.g. v_1a2b3c4d

locale.description: Response language, one of the 20 published languages (en, ro, fr, de, es, it, sr, hr, pt, pl, cs, sk, hu, no, sv, el, bg, da, ar, tr). Spec labels and enum values come back translated. Default: en.

tools.name: filter_catalogue
tools.description: Structured filter over all 103,372 variants (not only the 40-car demo): fuel, body, drive layout, power/price range, model year, EV-only. Keyset-paginated; returns opaque variant_ids for get_specs_full / compare_full. Paid per call with x402 (USDC) — $0.005.

fuel.description: Fuel slug, e.g. electric, petrol, diesel, hybrid

body.description: Body type slug, e.g. suv, hatchback, sedan

drive.description: Drive layout, substring match — front, rear, all

year.description: Production year the generation covers, e.g. 2022

ev.description: true = battery-electric variants only. Default: false

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page, to continue it

locale.description: Response language, one of the 20 published languages (en, ro, fr, de, es, it, sr, hr, pt, pl, cs, sk, hu, no, sv, el, bg, da, ar, tr). Spec labels and enum values come back translated. Default: en.

tools.name: compare_full
tools.description: Side-by-side localized specs for 2-4 variants from ANYWHERE in the 103,372-variant catalogue, in 20 languages. Paid per call with x402 (USDC) — $0.1 flat for the call. Not charged when an id is unknown.

variant_ids.description: 2 to 4 opaque variant ids from search_catalogue or filter_catalogue, e.g. ['v_1a2b3c4d', 'v_5e6f7a8b']

locale.description: Response language, one of the 20 published languages (en, ro, fr, de, es, it, sr, hr, pt, pl, cs, sk, hu, no, sv, el, bg, da, ar, tr). Spec labels and enum values come back translated. Default: en.
